I was there on Saturday and told the doctor I'd felt like there was fluid in my inner ear for weeks. He said it wasn't that, there was something else in my ear. He cleaned it and charged 1,200 baht (for 10 minutes).

Four days passed, nothing changed. It still felt the same in my ear. I went back and the doctor checked again and said – surprise, surprise – it looks like there might be fluid in my inner ear. I should go to the hospital to be sure because he couldn't do anything. Paid another price: 500 baht.

So he made two completely different diagnoses for the same problem and didn't solve it, costing 1,700 baht. No receipts for either payment. Definitely won't go there again and won't recommend anyone to go there.
